description:
Get derived metrics time series for a metric view

Return a derived metrics time series for one or more companies using a predefined metric view (bundle). Views are opinionated metric sets such as 'core_fundamentals' that group margins, growth rates, cash flows, leverage, and returns. EDGAR-only routes reject bundles that require external market inputs.

This endpoint reuses the same time-series structure as `/v1/edgar/derived-metrics/time-series` but selects metrics via the bundle code.

bundle_code.description: Metric view (bundle) code, e.g. 'core_fundamentals'. Bundle codes are case-insensitive.

ciks.description: Companies named by CIK. Repeat the parameter (for example `?ciks=0000320193&ciks=0000789019`) or separate CIKs with commas. Send this or `tickers`, not both. At most 25 companies per request.

from_date.description: Optional lower bound on statement_date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: Derived financial metrics used in analytics and modeling.

metrics.description: Optional list of derived metric codes to include. When a bundle_code is provided, explicit metrics are not allowed.

statement_type.description: Statement type used as the base for derived metrics (INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET, CASH_FLOW_STATEMENT).

tickers.description: Companies named by ticker symbol, in place of `ciks`; send one or the other. Repeat the parameter or separate symbols with commas. Each resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none. At most 25 companies per request.

to_date.description: Optional upper bound on statement_date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD).

name: views_metrics_get
